cohort: 19,506 newborns delivered at the University Clinic of Gynecology and Obstetrics Tuzla between 2012 and 2016, including 1,350 preterm births (gestational age 24-37 weeks)
finding: Vaginal delivery was more common in singleton pregnancies, especially at higher gestational ages and birth weights, and was associated with higher Apgar scores compared to cesarean delivery in this cohort of preterm births.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery (VD) was more frequent in the higher gestational ages, as well as the higher Apgar scores in singletons in contrast to twin deliveries.
